title: オークスの後に・樫の花は……

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Pant… huff… Oh…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I wasn't able to make… the full 2,400 meters…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Pant… pant… pant…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …Phew.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, Nishino Flower is so exhausted she can't even move, so I have her lie down for a while.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes. Sorry…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I really am… so sorry I couldn't win…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But… if I had just tried a little harder, and trained instead of resting…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: If I put more thought into my physical condition, today could have been different…
choice_data_list: Doing your best is never a mistake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't say she was in peak condition when she took on today's race, but the reason for her loss lies elsewhere.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her next race, the Shuka Sho, is a medium-distance race, like the one she just ran. However, considering today's results…
choice_data_list: (2,400 meters is too long a distance for her… If anything…)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I was watching you run from up here. You were so wonderfully fast, just like a cutting gale.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. And when that blossom finally blooms, we will face each other on the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There are other races where Nishino Flower can make the best use of her talents.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes?
choice_data_list: Let's take the Shuka Sho off your schedule.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Does that mean…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I didn't live up to your expectations?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's worked hard in the lead-up to today's race. With some further adjustments, running in the Shuka Sho would also be a viable option. However…
choice_data_list: I think there's a stage you'd shine even brighter on.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Shine even brighter? What do you mean?
choice_data_list: I think you should try doing sprints.
I think you should try doing sprints.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …It's actually a relief to hear that. Honestly, I already knew things might come to this.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Oaks is a big race, so I wanted to try my best for it…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But it was a little too much for me, and there were times when things felt incredibly tough…
choice_data_list: Thanks for trying so hard, Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… Thank you too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm sure I can perform even better in sprints, so let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So… what should we set as my goal? Considering the season, should we aim for a graded race in the summer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her reasoning is sound. Running in one of the summer races of the sprint tour is one way to get her used to them, but she can aim for something even bigger!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! But isn't that a G1 race?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You want me to run that right after changing course? Not to mention there'll be senior-year racers participating…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This will be Nishino Flower's first time running in a race with older competitors.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Compared to them, I'm still just a kid, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Will I even stand a chance?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower has always been self-conscious about how much younger she is compared to other racers, so I understand why she's worried about running with older Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Not as I am right now…
choice_data_list: That's why we have the summer to train.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The academy's summer camp will be starting soon, and Umamusume tend to make vast improvements during that time.
choice_data_list: I'll be right here with you, so let's get better together!
I'll be right here with you, so let's get better together!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …Okay. Then I'll follow your lead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we decide to make our next goal the G1 Sprinters Stakes.
